verdict.rationale: Vercel's core product is Git-push serverless deployment with zero-config framework support (Next.js and 40+ frameworks), on-demand server-side execution via Fluid compute, edge middleware, ISR, automatic previews, and rollback/promotion tooling—clearly delivering no-server-management full-stack deployment, backed by first-party docs, CLI, and probes confirming live infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of actual zero-ops experience beyond docs/community anecdotes.
